sources.note: Accepted: 3 pieces (3 cuts), kind note+instruction; single-language; 3 in a row the source stores in this language only; lengths 108/63/97; 1 piece carry more than one sentence and stand as one passage in the manual-v1 style. Wording, diacritics, protected markers and repetition are unchanged.

issues.note: The fa field holds text in the other language here; it sits in that language's slot as note, with wording and word order untouched, so nothing is translated or reordered.

layout.note: All 1 sources are placed once, in order: 4 output rows, 0 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 63 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. No crossed pairings, no orphaned one-word heading rows and no detached section labels were left behind. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
